title: ReDocs comment (one JSON object per line in comments/<page-id>.jsonl)

id.description: Stable comment id, unique within the page thread.

author.description: Display name of whoever wrote it — a person or an agent.

anchor.description: Optional heading slug on the page this comment is attached to.

reply_to.description: Id of the comment this one replies to (same page thread).

resolved.description: Whether the thread this comment heads is marked resolved.
